rule: Polls only from pollsters in AAPOR's Transparency Initiative (John, 2026-09-29): the latest from up to five of them, and our own average of the ten most recent, the arithmetic shown. Asked as a choice between Jackson and Collins, and undecided voters were asked which way they leaned. These figures include those leaners. No second choices were asked, so under Maine's ranked-choice count these are first choices. Of the rest, 4% said neither and 3% someone else. The likely-voter figures use all 880 registered voters interviewed, each weighted by how likely they are to vote.
